what: What the design site's Vehicles review page shows for this car (R126). tools/vehicles/review/build.mjs turns this, vehicle.json, the bake and assets/profiles/<id>.json into art/ui/poc/vehicles/<id>/; tools/vehicles/review/check.mjs fails if any Vehicles-contract item is missing. Paths are repo-relative.
name: Postie Bike
summary: Rebuilt around classic CB50 architecture: a curved red/cream tank, exposed finned single-cylinder engine, open diamond frame, slim spoked wheels and one low right exhaust replace the scooter floor and leg shield. The postie rider, carrier, parcels and panniers retain the game identity. Exported triangles: 2287 / 877 / 593 within unchanged 2900 / 900 / 600 budgets. Physics hulls, wheel hubs, anchors and original hinges remain frozen. Owner review decides likeness.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.

reference.note: New references generated with Muse from the Honda 1971 CB50 architecture; prompts, cost and primary image are retained in refs/provenance.json. The real Honda image governs a single right exhaust where the generated rear view invents two. Reference | model | silhouette diff use identical frozen level cameras. Corrected masks retain silver engine parts and the separate front tyre. Same-mask LOD0 score .8164 before to .8563 after; this remains an interpretation, not a calibrated replica.

damage.note: Left to right: intact; front and back loose; the rider loose; wheel_F cambered; front detached; the rider thrown (detached, R121); back detached; wheel_F detached; rider and front detached; a stripped frame. Posed in a three.js viewer about each part's hinge line (tools/vehicles/evidence).

paints.pattern: Seat colour tints the tank panels and mudguards. The cream tank inset, postal-red panniers, hi-vis vest, parcels, mechanical metal and dark tyres retain their colours. The identity number uses the original rider-back roof_number anchor and HUD badge.
